title: Coordinate in a parity block
statement: For natural numbers $n,r,g$, the parity block consists of the indices $g r+j$ that are less than $n$, with $0\le j<r$. The coordinate associated to such a $j$ is the index $g r+j$ in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$.
